bio.text: Lauren Kuby, a Democrat, represents District 8 in the Arizona State Senate; according to her legislative biography, she was elected to the Senate in 2024.
She served on the Tempe City Council from 2014 to 2022 and has lived in Tempe for over 36 years.
Kuby holds a bachelor's degree from the University of Chicago and a master's in public history from Arizona State University, where she was a Senior Global Futures Scientist before retiring in 2023.
